lines.en: I scurry low over the sand.

lines.zh: 我的小脚在干土上打滑。
lines.en: My little feet slip on dry soil.

lines.zh: 我穿过凯恩塔组的碎石。
lines.en: I cross the Kayenta rubble.
I hurry along the dry riverbed.
I look back for fear of losing the young.
I slip through a tuft of dry grass.
I keep to the edge of the rocks.
I trot a few paces and stop.
I avoid a sandy hollow.
I shift into the shade.
I head down the slope.

lines.zh: 我找到一条窄缝钻进去。
lines.en: I find a narrow gap and duck in.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地经过那棵枯树。
lines.en: I pass the dead tree slowly.
I run on a little further.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在土上拖出一条线。
lines.en: My tail drags a line across the soil.
I stop and catch my breath.
I huddle by a stone, still.
Head up, my ears swivel.
I chew a bit of dry grass.
I scan around warily.

lines.zh: 我这么小，很容易被忽略。
lines.en: I'm so small I'm easily overlooked.
I press to the ground and listen.
Dawn turns to dusk; I'm awake.
Behind this dune it's quiet.
I curl into a ball.
Wind blows sand onto me.
I smell water far off.

lines.zh: 我一点一点地挪动重心。
lines.en: I shift my weight little by little.
I bury my nose in the sand.
I listen again; nothing stirs.
You block the way worse than a butte.
I peek out from behind a stone.
When you move, I want to run.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not daring to blink.
I'm small; you needn't mind me.
My ears have flattened to my back.
I edge slowly toward my burrow.

lines.zh: 孤峰的碎石后面才安全。
lines.en: Only the scree behind the butte is safe.

lines.zh: 我这小身子，在干土上一个打滑。
lines.en: This little body of mine slips on the dry earth.

lines.zh: 我退一步，又往前凑一点。
lines.en: I step back, then edge a little closer.
My cry is thin as an insect's.
I bolt a good distance away.
I hide behind a stone, trembling.
I drag one leg toward the rock crack.
That nearly knocked me over.
I curl into a small ball.
My little ribs rise and fall.
Six hit points; I can't run fast now.
The dry forest smells too strong.
I want to get back to my burrow.
Is that food? I don't dare.
The leaf in your hand is too far.
It smells good, and unfamiliar.
I edge a little nearer, cautious.
Set it down and I'll come.
I take a small bite and run.
This is tenderer than my usual fare.
I come back; there's some left.
I'm not greedy; enough and I go.
This will last me a day.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我一下子弹开。
lines.en: You touched me and I bolted.
I'm light; a bump doesn't hurt.
A string of tiny prints stays in the sand.

lines.zh: 翻过身来，四条腿有点乱。
lines.en: Rolled over, my four legs are all astray.
I dive into a rock crevice.
Sand gets in my eyes.
I press to the far side of the stone.
My tail. Let go.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的沙，凯恩塔的风真干。
lines.en: I shake off the sand; the Kayenta wind is dry.
That sent me back into hiding.
Another small one comes near.
I wrap my tail over its back.
It's even more timid than me.
We sit pressed together in the sand.
This clutch should be hidden deep.
The sand is warm; just right.
It leans its body against mine.
Both our ears stand up.
We're ready to bolt at any moment.
At dawn we part.
I paw at it.
I snatch it and run.
This barely fills a gap in my teeth.
I drag it into the burrow.
I can't crack this seed.
I sniff before deciding.
I hug it and curl up.
It's bigger than me.
The Kayenta sand is very fine.
I stow this find away.
There's something edible over there.
On the desert edge, I lay eggs.
I see it, behind the stone.
First I check for danger.
Fine, I'll go.
Just that small piece.

lines.zh: 它就在不远处，我听到了。
lines.en: It is close by, I heard it.
I crouch low and move slowly.
In the dawn light, I move first.
Something blocks the river path.
I go round the far side of the stone.
I know this ground; easy going.
There are still eggs in my nest.
There's no wind in the dry forest.
It's quiet around; good.
I go a little further.
I keep to the stones.
It's still there, unmoving.
A small beast like me guards its eggs.
This distance is nothing.
I'm ready to run at any moment.
Almost; right ahead.
I prick my ears, then lower them.
Its shadow hasn't moved; good.
My belly nearly touches the sand.
I scratch with a forepaw.
My front teeth only manage bark.
My teeth are tiny; I can't bite deep.
I bumped it and tumbled.
This strength only guards me.
I hide again quickly.
It doesn't seem to mind me.
This bite lands by your boot.
My small body hits like a pebble.
I retreat behind the dune.
I snap my jaws at nothing.
I only want to drive it off.

lines.zh: 凯恩塔的沙洞，是我挖的。
lines.en: I dug that sand burrow in Kayenta.

lines.zh: 凯恩塔组的干地上，我在这。
lines.en: On the Kayenta's dry ground, I'm here.
I peek out of a rock crack.
I scurry across the open ground.
I was wary from birth.
The sand here is dry and warm.
I stop and look all around.
I shouldn't have been seen.
I move slowly along the ground.

lines.zh: 这地方有比我大的东西。
lines.en: There are bigger things here than me.
I run a circle around the dune.
First I sniff all around.
Sand slips from under my feet.
I raise my head and see you.

lines.zh: 热风一过，我的毛都焦了。
lines.en: The hot wind singes my fur.

lines.zh: 半格高的小兽，摔一下就晕。
lines.en: A half-block beast dazed by one fall.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我拼命挣。
lines.en: Water reaches my nose and I thrash.
The blast throws me into the air.
The fur by my ear is singed.
Small as I am, burrows are safest.
Too hungry to even run.
The thunder is too close; I curl up.
No sand here, and no burrow.
